notes: The word 'no' appears in the fixed core row (Row 1) as 'NO'; however it is so central to this specific book's interactive read-aloud experience (children shout 'No!' at the pigeon) that keeping a fringe version labelled 'no' gives students a direct, book-contextual button to use enthusiastically during the activity. Teachers may choose to drop it and substitute another word (e.g. 'hot dog' — the pigeon's coveted treat) if the core NO button is felt to be sufficient. Existing activity_images icons (pigeon, bus, steering_wheel_3, stop_sign, bus_driver) can populate the board directly. Existing aac_extras (shout, mad, ask) also map directly to fringe words here.
